description: Buzz team chat inside VS Code: channels and threads with your AI agents, send code and errors to them, review their proposals as diffs, and see what was said about the code you are reading.
cmd.sendProblem: Send problem on this line to an agent
cmd.sendTerminalSelection: Send terminal selection to an agent
cmd.sendDiff: Send git diff to a channel
cfg.language: Interface language. "auto" follows the VS Code display language. You can also switch with EN / TR at the top right of the chat.
cfg.cliPath: Path to the Buzz CLI. Empty: found automatically (Windows: %LOCALAPPDATA%\Buzz\buzz.exe; Mac: ~/.local/bin/buzz; or on PATH).
cfg.relayUrl: Relay address. Empty: read from the 'Relay:' line in ~/.buzz/AGENTS.md.
cfg.live: Connect to the relay live (messages arrive instantly, like Buzz Desktop). When off or unreachable, the chat refreshes by polling.
cfg.refreshSeconds: Refresh interval of the open chat in seconds when there is no live connection. After sending, it refreshes every 2.5 s for 3 minutes.
cfg.mentionSeconds: Mention check interval in seconds. 0 turns notifications off.
cfg.jira.url: Your Jira address, e.g. https://jira.example.com. Empty: Jira is off. Buzz: Connect Jira sets it.
cfg.jira.projects: Project keys whose issue keys (ABC-123) link to Jira in messages. Buzz: Connect Jira sets them.
cfg.lens.enabled: Buzz Lens: a bee in the gutter marks code that was discussed in Buzz; hover the line to see the conversation, and the status bar counts the file's conversations. Read from Buzz search when the file opens; nothing is written to the repository.
cmd.lensFile: Show Buzz conversations about this file
cfg.lens.inline: Also show Buzz Lens as gray lines above the code (GitLens style).
cmd.openAgentFile: Open a file from the agents' copy
cfg.agentRepos: Folders of the agents' git repositories. Empty: every git checkout under ~/.buzz/REPOS. File links, Show diff and Buzz Lens read the agents' version from there (read-only).
cfg.agentBranch: Branch of the agents' repositories that file links, Show diff and Buzz Lens show.
cfg.proposals.applyLocally: Also offer "Apply", which writes a proposal into your own workspace (off: proposals only get "Show diff").
cmd.addMember: Add a member to a channel…
cmd.channelMenu: Channels: new, join, add a member
cfg.desktopPath: Path to Buzz Desktop (the app), to start it from the chat when the agents are offline. Empty: found automatically (Windows: %LOCALAPPDATA%\Buzz\buzz-desktop.exe; Mac: /Applications/Buzz.app).
cmd.diagnostics: Diagnostics (what the extension sees on this computer)
cfg.jira.email: Jira Cloud only: the e-mail of your Atlassian account, sent with the API token. Leave empty for Jira Server / Data Center (personal access token). Set by Buzz: Connect Jira.
